2125062131376931177.content_en:
[Notice] Latest: Can overseas FX domestic bank transfers still be used from December onward?

In addition to the 7 companies I posted about earlier, I have now confirmed replies from XM and HFM.

🆕XMTrading / Deposits and withdrawals work as usual, but if problems arise they will adjust priorities and procedures

🆕HFM / Still available, no restrictions planned; if problems occur they will guide customers to other payment methods

📌BigBoss / Use from December onward is undecided at this point

📌Exness / Available from December onward, no suspension planned at this point

📌FXGT / Details not yet finalized, so they cannot give guidance

📌ThreeTrader / Still gathering information and considering; cannot share anything confirmed

📌Titan FX / No suspension planned at this point, but they will respond as the situation requires

📌XS / No suspension planned at this point, but they recommend methods such as crypto

📌VantageTrading / Still available, but they recommend transfers via stablecoins

I'm putting together an article with the details! 📝

👇 What changes in December? What is the revised Payment Services Act?
https://t.co/Y12j4prQ4O

【注目】最新版：12月以降も海外FXの国内銀行送金を使える？

先日投稿した7社に加え、XM・HFMからの回答も確認しました。

🆕XMTrading
通常どおり入出金可能だが問題が生じた場合は優先順位・手続きを調整する

🆕HFM
引き続き利用可能で制限の予定もなし、問題が発生した場合は他の決済方法を案内する

📌Exness
12月以降も利用可能、停止の予定も現時点ではなし

📌FXGT
現時点では詳細が確定しておらず案内できない

情報収集・検討している段階で確定した情報を伝えることはできない

📌Titan FX
現時点で停止の予定はないが状況に応じて対応していく

📌XS
現時点で停止する予定はないが仮想通貨などの方法を推奨

📌VantageTrading
引き続き利用可能だがステーブルコインでの送金を推奨

詳細はただいま記事にまとめています！📝
